title: DP World (Ports, Customs and Free Zone Corporation) - proposed acquisition of P&O Ports (the Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Company)

body_sections.Summary: DP World (Ports, Customs and Free Zone Corporation) owns, operates and manages container terminals and other port infrastructure around the world. DP World, through DPI Terminals, has a presence in Adelaide. P&O Ports (the Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Company) is a global container terminal and stevedore services provider with a presence in 19 countries, operating 29 container terminals and logistics operations at over 100 ports worldwide. P&O Ports' Australian subsidiaries lease, operate and manage terminals in Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle.
body_sections.Market definition: The relevant market for the assessment of the proposed acquisition was considered to be the markets for the supply of stevedoring services in each of Melbourne, Adelaide and Fremantle.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC concluded that the proposed acquisition would not result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets given the limited competitive overlap in the operations of DP World and P&O Ports in Australia.
